rules_evaluated.evidence: L17 "Before any check runs, decide whether your system is safe" puts the guess instruction ahead of any outcome; the reveal (L29 "The report opens with your guess. Below it are the rows your guess could not see") comes two chunks later. Muted read: L17 is a verbed sentence, no terminal-pointing cue.

Closest: chunk 7 "Take stock of the packaged check" L85-87 is one thin sentence, but L91 "The policy files are source material. The skill carries the judgment about what matters in this system" gives the chunk a self-carrying claim; thinness of the L85 recap is filed under rule 6.

chunk 7 "Take stock of the packaged check": L85-87: "**What happened:**" followed by "Module 4's audit exercise loads the skill and runs it against the same system." The bolded lead promises a recap of what the student did; the sentence under it is a forward pointer to a future exercise, so the lead is untrue of its own content. Harm present: the slide projects a "What happened" label over text that did not happen yet. The recap that made the label true ("The reusable check exists now, with two lenses...") was cut in the diff 4d9c4af2..HEAD.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Make the line a recap that carries the pointer: "**What happened:** You wrote and installed the skill. Module 4's audit exercise loads it and runs it against the same system."

rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L67 "the data your agent touches that would be a problem if it leaked, the rule your legal team cares about most, the customer your CEO would not want named in a transcript" is a three-item list, but each leg is concrete new content, not anaphora. Sub-items: no "Not X. Not Y. Z." (grep "Not " body → none), no self-grading superlative, no number+retraction, no empty verb triplet.

suggestions.now: The policy files are source material. The skill carries the judgment about what matters in this system, with all four risk patterns as mandatory checks. Agent mitigations sit on top of normal company controls, not in place of them. The first loaded use should be the real audit.
